items.claim: Honor canceled and prevented controlled changes
items.consequence: When a controlled `onValueChange` updates the value but calls `details.cancel()`, or the native event was prevented, the prop update still reaches this effect, which clears errors and validates it. The event handler returns before checking either flag, so controlled inputs no longer honor the existing prevented-event behavior or the new cancellation behavior.

items.claim: Stop updating field state when a change is canceled
items.consequence: For an uncontrolled input, `details.cancel()` skips validation but still updates dirty and filled state before the cancellation check. A consumer canceling a change therefore still observes `data-dirty` and `data-filled` change, rather than cancellation stopping the internal handling.
